newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS cuts Frontier to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS cuts Frontier to hold.

text.p: -- UBS Securities cut its rating on Frontier Corp to hold from buy and reduced its earnings estimates after the company's dismal earnings forecast.
-- UBS said it cut its forecasts due to revenue shortfall and higher SG&A costs from new marketing initiatives.
-- Frontier lost 6-1/8 to 20-1/4 after after it said expected fourth quarter earnings to fall below year-ago results and Wall Street consensus estimates.
-- Frontier said it expects to report fourth quarter earnings per share from recurring operations in the range of $0.30 to $0.34 in the fourth quarter.
-- UBS lowered its fourth quarter earnings estimate to $0.31 a share from $0.41 a share.

-- UBS also cut its full year 1996 estimates to $1.50 a share from $1.60 a share. The firm also cut its 1997 estimates by $0.25 a share to $1.60 a share and its 1998 estimates by $0.40 a share to $1.80 a share.
-- Shares were trading at 20-1/2, down 5-7/8 in latre afternoon trading.
